newsitem.title: USA: N.J. Gov vetoes bill to link Camden, Phila. ports.
newsitem.headline: N.J. Gov vetoes bill to link Camden, Phila. ports.

text.p: New Jersey Gov Christine Whitman said Friday she had conditionally vetoed legislation that would facilitate the unification of ports in Camden and Philadelphia.

Whitman urged lawmakers to remove provisions in the bill she viewed as unconstitutional. The provisions allow New Jersey's Senate president and Assembly speaker to appoint two members to the port's board.
The Governor also recommended that lawmakers give the state's Economic Development Authority and Treasury Department discretion to set annual rent payments at the port.
